name: Santa Cruz trek
why: The classic of the Cordillera Blanca: four days among 6,000 m peaks, over Punta Unión with Taulliraju above a turquoise lake.
book: Huascarán park multi-day ticket. Most go with an agency from Huaraz (donkeys, cook, transfer).
dangers: Punta Unión at 4,750 m: be acclimatised.
Night frost at every camp from June to August.

points.name: Vaquería
points.note: Day 1: the trek leaves the Portachuelo road at 3,700 m and goes down to the Huaripampa valley; first camp at Paria.

points.name: Punta Unión pass with Taulliraju
points.note: Day 2: the 4,750 m notch in the rock wall, Taulliraju above the turquoise Taullicocha; camp at Taullipampa below.

points.name: Alpamayo viewpoint
points.note: Day 3: the fluted ice pyramid of Alpamayo up the Arhuaycocha side valley (a 3-4 h side trip to its lake).

points.name: Laguna Jatuncocha
points.note: Day 3: the long lake of the Santa Cruz valley; camp at its end or at Llamacorral.

points.name: Cashapampa
points.note: Day 4: down the narrow Santa Cruz gorge to the village at 2,900 m, transport to Caraz.
